text:
The tower stairs turned back on themselves, and Mara climbed with one hand on the cold stone. She did not hurry. Hurrying told people things about you, and she had spent years telling them nothing. At the landing she stopped, listened, and heard only her own breath and the wind worrying at a shutter somewhere above.

[MISSING FACT]: The name of the guard posted at the tower landing is not established in canon.
